Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Yasu Dreneth: 35-year-old man, 157 cm (short), exceptional bodybuilder construction with enormous but coherent human muscle mass, skin value band-1-lightest. Face: heart-shaped face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; short rounded nose, wide mouth; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: violet-plum-pink, short-textured-crop, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: tailored-longcoat, specifically a cloth longcoat with a readable waist, split hem, plain underlayer, and fitted shoes; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette lilac-smoke. Visible personal details: one bounded geometric forearm tattoo; one wide engraved hair cuff on one side, with no other hair or ear jewelry. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: low-maintenance grooming with highly polished footwear. Color treatment: uses the palette boldly in large blocks. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a tiny cloth-wrapped notebook only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
